xml.log: If there is an update when the file file is missing, go to Steam Client - Library List - mydockfinder - right-click menu - Properties - Local File - Verify software file integrity If the desktop icon is not displayed after enabling pre-stage scheduling, you can right-click on the desktop-view-display desktop icon to enable display desktop icon Changelog ·Cancel the GPU multithreading optimization feature ·Corrected the German and English translations, thanks to netizen @Medienflow ·Fix the issue in all previous versions where screen corners sometimes displayed incorrectly when the screen resolution changed ·Optimize built-in window display animation and synchronize it with global window display animation ·Fix the issue in all previous versions where missing built-in theme icons caused infinite loop memory leaks ·Adjust global D3D11 level from 11.1 to 11.0 to improve compatibility and stability ·Fix the issue in all previous versions where Launchpad failed to retrieve all icons if it could not get Start menu or desktop icons, resulting in no icons displaying in Launchpad ·Adapt to Kugou Music full screen mode ·Fix the issue in all previous versions where MyFinder menu detection caused Kugou Music interface to freeze ·Optimize dock window boundaries when they are not 0, adding dock move animation when Launchpad is opened ·Adapt to some pure white/black icons, which will change brightness based on icon mask color ·Adjust MyFinder tray icon persistence configuration, modify it to a system virtual path to prevent persistence configuration failure caused by path changes after some UWP app updates. After this update, some programs’ persistence settings will be invalid and need to be reset, and fix the issue in all previous versions where some programs could not persist in the MyFinder tray icon ·Optimize UWP app icon retrieval and fix the issue where some UWP app icons did not display ·Fix the issue in all previous versions where enabling foreground scheduling could cause windows near the scheduling window list to shrink into the list when the current window was resized ·Adapt to Windows 11 built-in screenshots to prevent display animation from causing screenshot abnormalities ·Fix the issue in all previous versions where Dock progress bar caused extremely high CPU usage and memory leaks in rare cases ·Optimize CPU usage when enlarging dock icons ·Optimize CPU usage during minimized window animation rendering ·Fix the issue in all previous versions where quickly showing and disappearing window previews could occasionally cause crashes ·Fix the previous version issue where MyFinder and Dock rendering occasionally did not display images ·Fix the issue in all previous versions where the Dock's overall position shifted after resolution changes ·Optimize detection of multiple monitors of the same model, displaying the corresponding monitor number for each monitor name
